# AgentSecure Community

AgentSecure lets AI coding agents use credentials without exposing the real
secret values to the agent.

The default workflow is: install AgentSecure, run guided setup once, apply the
MCP configuration, then start Claude Code or Codex normally. Secret-bearing
HTTP requests use `agentsecure.http.request`. Do not present
`agentsecure run -- <agent>` as the default.

For Claude Code, run `agentsecure start --client claude`. For Codex, run
`agentsecure start --client codex --install-mcp`.

## Default setup
